project_info.title: AVIORTEX — Premium Industrial B2B Sewing Production
project_info.target_audience: Corporate clients, retail brands, delivery services, event agencies, promotional companies
project_info.design_tone: Premium industrial, minimal, highly authoritative, tactile, confident, clean editorial

style_archetype.name: Swiss Industrial Precision & Warm Monochrome
style_archetype.background_philosophy: Mostly clean warm whites (#FAFAFA, #FFFFFF) and architectural light grays (#F4F3F0, #EAE8E3). Selective midnight industrial dark sections (#0D0D0D, #141414) for high-impact visual contrast.
style_archetype.typography_philosophy: Uncompromising black typography (#0F0F0F), high contrast ratios, wide tracking for labels, tight tracking for display titles.
forbidden_patterns: No generic AI purple/blue gradients (#7351B7 is forbidden)
No price tags or invented claims
No rounded bubbly colorful buttons — use crisp rectangular or subtle rounded industrial buttons
No cramped card layouts — double/triple padding everywhere
No plain unstyled text inputs — high-precision dark/light input fields

typography.heading_font: Syne, Cabinet Grotesk, or Unbounded / Barlow style sans (Bold uppercase industrial display weight)
typography.body_font: Inter or DM Sans (High legibility, extended line-height for Russian Cyrillic)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (For numeric step markers, trust metrics, technical specs)

scale.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-extrabold uppercase leading-[1.05]
scale.section_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-bold uppercase text-neutral-900
scale.mono_label: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-widest uppercase text-neutral-500

key_features_and_motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic line-by-line masked text reveal using Framer Motion with staggerChildren
key_features_and_motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll wrapper integrated in App.js
key_features_and_motion.editorial_marquee: Slow, elegant auto-scrolling industrial ribbon featuring production keywords
key_features_and_motion.parallax: Subtle translate-y motion on hero image and workshop cards during scroll
key_features_and_motion.order_manifesto: 5 numbered chapters with accordion/tab reveal detailing the production workflow
key_features_and_motion.whatsapp_calculator: Interactive order calculation form that composes pre-filled WhatsApp link (`https://wa.me/77077272363?text=...`)
key_features_and_motion.floating_whatsapp: Persistent bottom-right floating WhatsApp button with active status ping

sections_breakdown.name: Hero & Trust Indicators
sections_breakdown.content: Kinetic headline: «Швейное производство для вашего бизнеса». Subtitle: 15+ лет на рынке Казахстана, 2000+ выполненных заказов. CTA buttons: «Рассчитать стоимость» (scroll to calc) and «Связаться в WhatsApp». Trust metrics bar: 15+ лет опыта, 2000+ клиентов, Доставка по всему Казахстану.
sections_breakdown.layout: Grid split hero on desktop, stacked on mobile with high-contrast background overlay.

sections_breakdown.name: 6 Product Categories (Продукция)
sections_breakdown.layout: Asymmetric Bento Grid with spotlight image cards, quick action 'Запросить расчет' triggering pre-selection in form.

sections_breakdown.name: Нам доверяют бизнесы (Clients & Gallery)
sections_breakdown.content: Case studies of corporate clients + high-res gallery of real branded textile work.

sections_breakdown.name: Как сделать заказ (5 Manifesto Steps)
steps: 01. Консультация и ТЗ (Обсуждаем задачи, тираж, материалы и сроки)
02. Образец и расчет (Отшиваем тестовый образец, согласовываем качество)
03. Договор и оплата (Фиксируем цены, параметры и сроки выполнения)
04. Пошив и ОТК (Массовое производство с двойным контролем качества)
05. Доставка (Упаковка и отправка по Алматы и всему Казахстану)

sections_breakdown.name: Калькулятор заказа (WhatsApp Order Composer)
fields: Тираж (Количество: slider or number input, e.g. 50, 100, 500, 1000+)
sections_breakdown.action: Opens WhatsApp with formatted message: «Здравствуйте! Хочу рассчитать стоимость пошива: [Продукция], тираж: [Количество] шт. Мое имя: [Имя], тел: [Телефон].»

sections_breakdown.name: О компании AVIORTEX
sections_breakdown.content: 15+ лет производственной экспертизы в Алматы. Парк современный швейных машин, раскройный цех, печатное и вышивальное оборудование.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lenis` (@studio-freight/lenis or lenis) for smooth scrolling.
Implement Framer Motion kinetic headline reveal with line masking on load.
Include mandatory testids on ALL interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, nav links, tabs, WhatsApp trigger).
Ensure Russian text is natural, professional, and contains NO prices or non-verified facts.
Ensure total responsiveness for mobile down to 390px width.
Integrate sonner toast notifications for feedback on form actions.
